evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~343-345 °C, physically implausible versus column temps 58-76 °C at 400 mbar, and creeps monotonically upward
Reflux flow near zero (0.005-0.19 L/h) while FYI702 reports ratio ~3.6-4.9, inconsistent with FT704 ~0.45 L/h
Column profile essentially flat/steady for 20 min, no separation front movement

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature check (or sensor recalibration) and a reflux-flow verification to determine whether FT703/FYI702 disagreement is metering or actual no-reflux operation; plus a distillate composition sample.
